sections.title: AI Services for Dallas Supply Chain Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for DFW's world-class supply chain ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Cross-Border US-Mexico Supply Chain
paragraphs: DFW is the primary logistics hub for the US-Mexico trade corridor — the world's largest bilateral trade relationship between neighboring countries:

Cross-border demand forecasting: ML for the unique demand patterns of US-Mexico trade — incorporating Mexican manufacturing cycles, peso-dollar exchange rate effects on procurement timing, and the seasonal patterns of the maquiladora sector's production for DFW importers and logistics companies.

Customs clearance analytics: ML predicting CBP examination selection, clearance timeline, and broker workload for the enormous US-Mexico trade flow through DFW's customs district — helping importers plan for clearance variance in high-volume cross-border corridors.

Bilingual supply chain documentation: AI processing Spanish-language shipping documents, Mexican customs documentation (pedimentos), and Mexican supplier invoices — essential for the US companies managing Mexican supplier relationships through DFW.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | CBP, C-TPAT context

blocks.heading: Rail and Intermodal Logistics
paragraphs: For BNSF Railway (Fort Worth HQ) and the intermodal logistics community serving DFW's central US geography:

Rail network delay prediction: ML for BNSF's North Texas rail operations — predicting delay propagation through the complex interchange junctions, hump yards, and intermodal ramps in the Dallas-Fort Worth rail network.

Intermodal equipment management: ML for chassis availability prediction, container tracking, and equipment repositioning optimization for the intermodal logistics companies operating through DFW's Alliance Inland Port.

Class I interchange analytics: ML for the performance of BNSF's interchanges with UP, CSX, and NS at DFW's rail junction points — predicting interchange delay and optimizing shipment routing through North Texas's complex rail topology.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Airline and MRO Supply Chain
paragraphs: For American Airlines (Fort Worth HQ) and the aviation MRO community clustered near DFW:

Aircraft spare parts demand forecasting: ML for American Airlines' vast MRO inventory — predicting aircraft on ground (AOG) parts demand incorporating fleet age, maintenance schedule density, and unscheduled maintenance patterns from American's 900+ aircraft fleet.

MRO vendor and repair station analytics: ML for American's MRO supply chain performance — predicting vendor delivery, quality, and turnaround time for the hundreds of repair stations serving American's maintenance operations.
Fuel supply chain optimization: ML for American's fuel purchasing and hedging operations — the second-largest cost item for any airline after labor.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Industrial Distribution and B2B Supply Chain
paragraphs: For Grainger (Fort Worth distribution center, one of the US's largest industrial distributors), Fastenal, and the industrial distributor community:
Industrial demand forecasting: ML for industrial supply demand — maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) demand driven by DFW's large manufacturing and construction sector activity.
Distribution center optimization: ML for inventory positioning, pick path optimization, and labor planning across DFW's large industrial distribution center complex.
Supplier risk analytics: ML for monitoring supplier financial health, quality performance, and delivery reliability for DFW's industrial distributors managing thousands of supplier relationships.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: AT&T Network Equipment Supply Chain
paragraphs: AT&T (Dallas HQ) operates one of the world's largest telecommunications networks — the supply chain for network equipment, consumer devices, and professional services is among the most complex in the technology industry:

Device inventory and demand forecasting: ML for AT&T's consumer device portfolio — predicting iPhone, Android, and Samsung Galaxy demand at channel, geography, and model level for AT&T's retail and e-commerce channels.

Network equipment deployment analytics: ML for AT&T's network equipment installation scheduling — predicting contractor availability, equipment delivery, and customer impact for AT&T's large capital expenditure deployment program.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks
